comment: Raised from 7981 to 8195 for the scheduler fixes of pull request 12: each fix costs 4 to 35 B gzip, most of it try/catch on error paths. Raised from 8195 to 8216 for issue 10: a State written in a batch compares its value at the end with the value its readers saw. Raised from 8216 to 8348 for issue 11: mark, settle and stale walk a chain of memos with a list in place of recursion, so a long chain does not overflow the stack on Melange. Lower it when the app gets smaller.
